faqs.a: Figma UI/UX for SaaS dashboards, mobile apps, websites and landing pages, design systems and UX audits. I also build sites in WordPress (Elementor and ACF), Shopify and Squarespace.
Figma for design and prototyping. For live sites I use WordPress with Elementor and ACF, Shopify and Squarespace, depending on what fits your business.

faqs.q: How long does a project take?
faqs.a: Smaller website and app screens usually take 2 to 5 days. Larger products take 1 to 4 weeks, and we agree on the timeline before we start.

faqs.q: Can you redesign my existing site or file?
faqs.a: Yes. I redesign outdated interfaces and can move designs from Framer, WordPress, Weebly or Adobe XD into a modern Figma system, then rebuild the site if you need it.
Message me on WhatsApp or send me a link to your app, website or Figma file. I’ll reply within an hour with 3 specific UX improvements, free.
